name: Wisconsin

response.rule_text: Records must be produced as soon as practicable and without delay (Wis. Stat. § 19.35(4)(a)); the RCFP text states no fixed day count.

fees.labor_rule: Locating fee only if actual, necessary and direct cost of locating exceeds $50 (§ 19.35(3)(c)); redaction cannot be charged (Milwaukee Journal Sentinel 2012).
fees.copy_rule: Actual, necessary and direct cost of reproduction and transcription (§ 19.35(3)(a)-(b)); mailing at actual cost.
fees.waiver_rule: Authority may waive or reduce fees in the public interest (§ 19.35(3)(e)).
fees.late_penalty: Prevailing requester gets damages of at least $100 plus attorney fees and costs (§ 19.37(2)); prepayment allowed only if total exceeds $5 (§ 19.35(3)(f)).

residency.rule_text: No residency rule in the RCFP text; only committed or incarcerated persons face limits (§ 19.32(3)).

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; mandamus under § 19.37(1) by requester, district attorney or AG in circuit court of county where custodian has an office; no limit in the law, three years under § 893.93(1m) may apply. AG advice available under § 19.39.

format_rule: Records covered regardless of physical form (§ 19.32(2)); no duty to create new records (§ 19.35(1)(L)); emails available electronically (Lueders v. Krug 2019).
notes: Read chars 0-195k. No fixed deadline located in RCFP (B.1 subsection empty); a 10-working-day figure did not appear and was not filled. Delay is not automatically a denial (§ 19.37(1)) but an uncertain-future-date response is (WTMJ v. Sullivan 1996). Executive branch not exempt; governor not named. RCFP chapter updated Sept 2020.
